decisive_spans.text: concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels

response.rationale: The vignette describes a bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels and positive CD31 immunostain, along with concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells around small vessels, scattered mitoses, and necrosis. These findings are highly supportive of Angiosarcoma (D2). Kaposi sarcoma (D8) is contradicted by negative staining for Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus. Squamous cell carcinoma (D7) is contradicted by the histological description of concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells, which is not characteristic of squamous cell carcinoma.
